testcase.name: a slideshow keeps its own cadence and never joins the comb
a slideshow advances on its fixed cadence, not on a random draw
two tiles never take the same turn, whenever each of them woke up
the slideshow is faster than R3 A8's band, so it reads as a slideshow
the index never runs off the end of the list
a live tile draws its period inside the measured band, end inclusive
the gap between neighbouring tiles is a whole slice of the band
the comb never divides by zero
a tile with one live face alternates with its front
every cycling tile shares one comb, whatever its transition
every advance takes exactly the same time
a turn is never zero, so a tile cannot flip twice in the same instant
a tile with three photos walks front, photo, photo, photo and comes back
a tile with no live faces stays on its front
an animation longer than the period means the next change is due now
the animation's own time comes out of the period
a tile on its own still waits its turn rather than flipping instantly
